newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Rugby union-Macqueen reappointed to coach ACT.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Macqueen reappointed to coach ACT.

text.p: Rod Macqueen has been reappointed as ACT rugby union coach for the next two seasons, it was announced on Thursday.
The appointment ends speculation that Macqueen was about to return to Sydney, possibly to coach New South Wales.
Macqueen is credited as the brainchild of ACT's spectacular performances in the Super-12 series this year.
The Brumbies have been unbeaten at home for the past two seasons and finished second in this year's tournament to Auckland, widely regarded as the world's best provincial side.
"Rod Macqueen's record over the past two years has established him as the leading coach in the Super 12 competition," ACT rugby union general manager Mark Sinderberry said in a statement.
"We are delighted that we have been able to secure Rod for another two years."
